thread:
Maria: FYI - Aurelia Health asked for a short POC next month. Must-haves: SAML SSO, SCIM user+group sync from AD, RBAC mapped to AD groups, multi-subdomain domain proofing, audit logs (365d default), and KMS options. They attached a security questionnaire.

Priya: Acknowledged. Do they want employeeNumber->externalId and dept->group mapping?

Alex: Yes we can map those. Quick SCIM example for onboarding: `{"userName":"a.santos@aurelia.health","externalId":"E123","emails":[{"value":"a.santos@aurelia.health","primary":true}],"groups":[{"value":"clinical"}]}`.

Sam: For sync use PATCH (delta) by default; full replace only if they request. We surface sync metrics and errors in Console.

Jordan: Security notes: Hosted = platform KMS; Dedicated/Private = BYOK. SOC2 available. Audit exports JSON/CSV and retention can be extended for a fee beyond 365 days. Domain verification requires TXT or file proof; MX-only won't pass InfoSec.

Casey: RBAC flows: Console > Settings > Identity lets you map SCIM groups to roles. For the POC we can pre-create viewer/editor/admin and map sample AD groups.

Luis: Pricing: SCIM included in enterprise tier. Dedicated is a separate reserved SKU (monthly commit). Offer two POC paths: Hosted 30d (usage billing) or Dedicated 30d trial with discounted commit for isolation/KMS.

Maria: They attached the questionnaire: https://redwood.box/aurelia-security-q.xlsx. Also asked for an on-call escalation contact and runbook.

Jordan: I'll own the questionnaire. SCIM rate limits: default 120 reqs/min on Hosted; negotiable for Dedicated. Retry uses exponential backoff + jitter.

Alex: Need their IdP metadata (or Okta test org) and 5 test users (1 admin, 2 editors, 2 viewers) CSV. We'll publish SP metadata within 24h of receiving IdP metadata. NameID should be email/persistent. Clock skew commonly causes failures.

Sam: I'll draft a 1-page ops runbook: SAML checks, SCIM troubleshooting, role mapping verification, and log export steps. ETA 24h.

Casey: Proposed timeline: Week0 metadata + test accounts; Week1 SAML + SCIM validation; Week2 RBAC & audit export; Week3 wrap/demo. Dedicated trial requires extra provisioning time.

Priya: I'll draft outbound to Aurelia with both POC options and note audit retention pricing + BAA/HIPAA next steps. Post in #sales-drafts for review.

Maria: Action items: Maria - collect IdP metadata/CSV + confirm questionnaire uploaded (done). Alex - prepare SP metadata & SCIM template (24h). Sam - ops runbook (24h). Jordan - security Q (48h). Casey/Priya - pricing + KMS differences (48h).

Luis: Domain note: we can handle wildcard subdomain verification via TXT on root; delegated domains may need owner-level proofs.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll send the response tomorrow AM after we review the draft. :thumbsup:
